blocks.text: Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation in Vienna, 58 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN developed and completed a comprehensive project for a 58 m² apartment in Vienna, Austria. The project combined interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture design and production, furnishing, and turnkey apartment renovation.

Particular attention was given to functional use of space, ergonomics and integrated storage solutions. In a 58 m² apartment, every square meter needs to be used efficiently while maintaining a comfortable, spacious and visually cohesive interior.

The custom-made furniture was designed together with the interior, allowing furniture and storage solutions to be precisely integrated into the architecture and layout of the apartment. This approach maximizes the available space while maintaining a consistent interior design concept.

Before implementation, a detailed project estimate was prepared covering the required works, materials, custom furniture, household appliances, sanitary equipment, lighting and other project elements. Following the design stage, the turnkey apartment renovation in Vienna was completed according to the developed technical documentation.

This 58 m² apartment project demonstrates DUMSKAYA DESIGN’s comprehensive approach to residential interiors in Vienna — from the initial design concept and technical solutions to custom furniture production and renovation.
